name: Progressive Control Closure
principles: One logical control cycle handles observed project events without requiring one service per capability.
Only a small ingress/control screen is universal; deeper work is activated progressively.
Ordinary natural language may be model-interpreted, but mandatory closure remains project-controlled and inspectable.
Explicit owner directives are preserved separately from inferred intent.
A low-consequence event may take an explicit no-additional-obligations fast path.
Reconstruction and activation continue until mandatory control obligations are satisfied, explicitly discharged, or fail-visible unresolved.
Derived control records are non-authoritative by default.
Current continuity remains semantic authority until explicit later switch.
Manual collaborator/tool transport is compatible with system-selected routing.
Postflight preservation, resume and self-observation are part of the same control loop.

logical_stages.name: event_ingress_and_explicit_intent
logical_stages.notes: May be model-assisted. Multi-facet events are allowed. Material uncertainty affecting consequential routing must remain visible.

logical_stages.name: baseline_control_context
logical_stages.notes: Uses compact fresh project state or already-valid interaction state; does not require whole-project reconstruction.

logical_stages.name: control_obligation_screening
logical_stages.notes: Determines mandatory/optional obligations and permits an explicit no-additional-obligations fast path.

logical_stages.name: progressive_reconstruction_and_activation_closure
logical_stages.notes: Reuses Candidate 01 task-shaped reconstruction. Newly surfaced material control facts may trigger bounded re-evaluation.

logical_stages.name: process_workstream_collaboration_tool_routing
logical_stages.notes: Selects process, workstream transition, collaboration topology, tool route and transport. Manual handoff may suspend the cycle.

logical_stages.name: authority_and_action_contract_preflight
logical_stages.notes: Required for consequential guidance/action. Exact revisions/private dependencies are bound when required.

logical_stages.name: reasoning_execution_or_handoff
logical_stages.notes: May be direct reasoning, tool work, governed mutation, manual Codex/Claude relay, recovery or human-decision request.

logical_stages.name: pre_dispatch_or_pre_mutation_conformance
logical_stages.notes: Checks that material action-contract constraints survive into proposed guidance/action before consequential dispatch.

logical_stages.name: postflight_preservation_resume_and_self_observation
logical_stages.notes: Verifies completion, preservation, workstream/resume implications, Git lifecycle consequences and control-plane failure/evolution evidence.

logical_records.name: EventInterpretation
logical_records.purpose: Preserve explicit directives separately from event/task hypotheses, consequence and routing-relevant uncertainty.

logical_records.name: ControlObligationSet
logical_records.purpose: State what control behavior is required, why it activated, how it is satisfied, and what happens if it cannot be satisfied.

logical_records.name: ReconstructionContract
logical_records.purpose: Task-shaped must-load/optional/negative context plus freshness, receipt and escalation requirements.

logical_records.name: RouteDecision
logical_records.purpose: Explain selected project process, workstream transition, collaboration topology, tool and transport route.

logical_records.name: ActionContract
logical_records.purpose: Material preconditions, ordered constraints, prohibitions and postconditions.

logical_records.name: ExecutionOrHandoffReceipt
logical_records.purpose: Record what was actually dispatched/performed and against what boundary when durable evidence is required.

logical_records.name: ContinuationReceipt
logical_records.purpose: Preserve enough bounded state to resume after interruption without turning conversation into authority.

logical_records.name: ControlObservation
logical_records.purpose: Record control failure, pressure, trigger or obligation-realization evidence for qualification/evolution.

conditions: no unresolved control condition whose applicability could materially change the route
fast_path.prohibition: Fast path cannot bypass mandatory authority, risk, review, recovery or preservation obligations.

trigger_boundary.rule: Model-assisted signals may nominate typed conditions; project-controlled policy determines mandatory obligations.

closure_rule.initial: derive obligations from event interpretation, explicit directives and bounded current control context
closure_rule.expansion: targeted reconstruction/activation may add or strengthen obligations when new material control facts appear
closure_rule.termination: all mandatory obligations are satisfied, explicitly discharged under policy, or fail-visible unresolved
closure_rule.safety: mandatory obligations cannot silently disappear between model passes

prospective_amendments.rule: Independently inspect the proposed output/action for consequential shape before final dispatch or consequential mutation. If a relevant shape fires and sufficient AuthorityReceipt/ActionContract closure is absent, re-enter bounded reconstruction/authority closure and then return to normal conformance.
non_effects: does not infer owner mutation permission
does not authorize the proposed action
does not make derived control evidence authoritative
does not adopt other Arm-D-only refinements
does not require deep reconstruction for ordinary low-consequence output
